Time just broke, and it happened inside a dying star. Physicists ran the numbers on a collapsing neutron star and got something nobody saw coming. Time running in reverse. Not slowing down. Actually going backward. Everywhere else in the universe, time only moves one way. Eggs don't unscramble. Cold coffee doesn't warm itself back up. But push the equations into the chaos of a neutron star caving in on itself and that one-way street flips. It's math. Still, somewhere out there, a star collapsing into itself might be the one place the clock winds back.

Kikuko Inoue is one of the most recognizable veteran Japanese voice actresses in anime. She became especially famous as Kasumi Tendo in Ranma ½ and Belldandy in Ah! My Goddess, two performances that helped define her early career. Her résumé continued through major anime and game franchises. She voiced Sanae Furukawa in Clannad, Lust in Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood, I-No in Guilty Gear, and Kirumi Tojo in Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony. She has also appeared in numerous other anime, games, and dubbing projects. Inoue has remained active for decades while developing a particularly recognizable style for elegant, mature, and motherly characters. Her voice has consequently become familiar across romance, comedy, fantasy, action anime, and video games. Which Kikuko Inoue character introduced you to her voice: Belldandy, Kasumi, Sanae, Lust, or I-No? Happy 62nd birthday, Kikuko Inoue.
